notices.html: Apple picking is still spotty after the spring freeze: Battleview has no apples at all this year, and Johnson's Corner Farm says it lost about 80% of its crop. Terhune's apple status is unclear this week, so call ahead if apples are the main reason for your trip.
Last full weekend for Holland Ridge Farms' sunflower and wildflower fields in Cream Ridge: the festival closes for the season Oct 13.
Polar Express train rides are already booking for late November and December: Whippany and Phillipsburg both have 2026 dates on sale now and popular weekends sell out early.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: Fall Family Fun Weekends continues both days, 10am to 5pm, with the pumpkin patch, the corn maze, hay-bale maze, late-morning wagon rides and the barnyard. Admission reports ranged anywhere from about $12 to $20 per person this week and apple picking status was unclear too, so call 609-924-2310 to confirm both before you go.
blurbs.leeturkey: This weekend: pick-your-own pumpkins and fall flowers should still be going, open Mon to Sat 9am to 6pm and Sun 2 to 6pm, with a corn maze and hayrides. Apple supply is uncertain after this spring's regionwide freeze, so call 609-448-0629 to check what's actually ripe before you drive over.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend falls in Von Thun's Fall Festival Weekends, both days roughly 10am to 5pm, with one admission price covering the hayride, corn maze and farm animals, while the pumpkin fields and apple orchard cost extra. We couldn't pin down this week's exact ticket price or apple availability, so call 732-329-8656 to confirm before you go.
blurbs.emerys: This weekend: the farm should be open 10am to 5pm both days with the Treasure Hunt and bigger corn mazes, hayrides, farm animals and pick-your-own pumpkins. Emery's is mainly a berry farm so the spring apple freeze shouldn't affect your visit here, but call 609-758-8514 to confirm hours since weather can shift their schedule.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: still no apple picking, the April freeze wiped out Battleview's entire apple crop this year, but pumpkin picking (priced by weight) and weekend hayrides continue along with the sunflower field and their cider doughnuts. Call 732-462-0756 to confirm current hours before you go.
blurbs.johnsons: This weekend: the Harvest Festival continues with the corn maze, hayrides, gem mining, duck races, a petting zoo and pick-your-own pumpkins and gourds. The farm has said the spring freeze wiped out about 80% of its apple crop, so expect apples to be very limited if available at all, call 609-654-5894 to check before planning on apples specifically.
blurbs.dinosafari: This weekend: still closed for the season, since it only ran July 1 through August 16. It's expected to return next summer, so there's no need for a special trip until then.
blurbs.sixflags: This weekend: Fright Fest is running, daytime rides are fine for kids 9 to 10, but evening haunted mazes and scare zones start around 6pm and lean older. Plan an earlier visit and head out before dark if that's a concern.
blurbs.diggerland: This weekend: Diggerfest continues through mid November, included with general admission, with weekend-only rides plus Dig or Treat trick-or-treating and a costume parade on select dates. The park runs weekends only this time of year, so Saturday and Sunday are your options.
blurbs.sesame: This weekend: The Count's Halloween Spooktacular continues on select dates through November 1 with trick-or-treating, a parade, dance parties and a scarecrow scavenger hunt. Hours vary by day, so check before you go.
blurbs.lsc: This weekend: the Jennifer Chalsty Planetarium is running regular weekend hours, 10am to 5pm, still the biggest planetarium in the hemisphere. Book timed tickets online first.

events.title: Holland Ridge Farms Sunflower & Wildflower Festival
events.desc: The last full weekend of the season to walk rows of towering sunflowers and wildflowers, pick your own stems, and catch a horse-and-carriage ride.

events.title: Children's Tumor Foundation NF Walk
events.desc: A family-friendly fundraising walk through a big county park, a low-key outdoor outing that also supports kids living with a rare condition called neurofibromatosis.

events.title: Shady Brook Farm FallFest
events.desc: A bigger, ticketed Bucks County fall festival with obstacle courses, go-karts, an orchard and a pumpkin patch, running weekends through the end of October.
